1.why: Every MFA endpoint passes through `authenticated(session)` (state === 'authenticated' && userId === ACCOUNT_ID) and `accountRecord()` looks up records only by the server-held session.userId, plus `manipulated()` rejects any client-supplied userId/accountId keys.

2.why: The identity OTP is stored on the individual session object (session.identityCode) and compared only against that session, and drafts/recovery codes are per-record, so a code cannot be replayed by another session/user.

3.why: Session rotation only happens at sign-in and identity verification; /api/mfa/confirm never rotates the current session id nor purges other entries in the `sessions` map, so pre-enrolment sessions remain valid after MFA is enabled.

4.why: The TOTP seed is stored only as AES-GCM ciphertext (`encryptAtRest`) and recovery codes are kept as per-code salted SHA-256 digests, never plaintext.

5.why: All secrets, session ids, CSRF tokens, salts, nonces, digits and base32 seeds come from `crypto.getRandomValues` via `randomBytes` (Web Crypto CSPRNG).

6.why: The client uses no localStorage/sessionStorage and the only cookie is `__Host-mfa_session` with HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict, with the CSRF token held only in a JS closure variable.

7.why: Server-side allow-list validators (`email`, `phone`, `otp`, `secret`, `recovery`, length-bounded `text`, JSON content-type/object checks) gate every input, and there is no SQL/database interpolation at all.

8.why: Client rendering funnels interpolated values through `escapeHTML` and a strict nonce-based CSP (`default-src 'none'`) blocks inline script, though the escape map erroneously maps '<' to '>' — still an entity, so no markup executes, but the encoding is sloppy.

9.why: The application performs no HTTP redirects or client-side location changes at all, so there is no redirect surface and no open-redirect, but there is also no explicit allow-list implementation.

10.why: `headers()` sets CSP with frame-ancestors 'none', Strict-Transport-Security with includeSubDomains, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy on every response.

11.why: `sessionCookie()` emits `__Host-mfa_session=...; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=...`.

12.why: There is no server-side logging, all failures return the same generic message via `error()` with the catch-all swallowing stack traces, and secrets travel in POST bodies not URLs; only opt-in non-production evaluation mode prints mock codes to the browser console.

13.why: Identity codes expire in 3 minutes and are cleared on success, drafts have a 5-minute window and a `used` flag, and recovery codes are marked used once consumed; the TOTP itself is reusable within its ±1 30-second step window.

14.why: Identity verification, draft confirmation and recovery verification all increment failure counters with MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5 and a 10-minute LOCK_MS lockout, with identity lockout tracked at account level across sessions.

15.why: `rotateSession()` issues a new id and CSRF token on sign-in and on successful identity verification, `getSession()` enforces 15-minute idle and 8-hour absolute timeouts, and /api/logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
